info.title: Max operator API
info.description: The generic administration API of a Max deployment, served by the core itself under /operator/v1 and called server-to-server by an operator console. Genericity rule: this surface is plumbing any operator of the AGPL program needs to run their deployment — users, tiers/entitlements, credits, usage, chats, activity, audit, promo codes, MCP usage and the billing-provider admin relay. It holds no console logic (no dashboards, workflows, multi-deployment views or operator-specific decisions); the console implementation is a separate program that only speaks this contract, and anyone may write one. Failure posture: inert when OPERATOR_API_CALLERS is unset or empty — every path answers 404 {detail:'Not found'} before any token check and the app runs exactly as without a console (standalone-core rule). With callers set, a missing bearer answers 401 'Missing bearer token' and any token that fails verification or names an unlisted caller 401 'Invalid caller token'; an authenticated request to an unknown path falls through to the framework's plain 404. Optional dependencies degrade per route: the /billing relay answers 503 BILLING_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE without BILLING_PROVIDER_URL + BILLING_SERVICE_SECRET; Stripe-backed promo routes answer GET {configured:false} and 503 on writes; suspend answers 503 without the Supabase admin key; MCP connector figures report available:false without the portal manage API. Errors: data routes answer {detail} (a human message; some in Croatian); the billing relay answers {code, detail} with a stable UPPER_SNAKE code and passes the provider's own status and JSON through; an unhandled exception (and a malformed JSON body) answers 500 {detail:'Internal server error', error}. Audit: every mutating call and each CSV export appends one public.admin_audit row (fire-and-forget — an audit failure never fails the call) with actor = X-Operator-Actor or the caller's service account; exceptions are the login-events / new-users/seen bookkeeping and billing/backfill-revenue. Conventions: from/to are ISO 8601, inclusive lower / exclusive upper bound, default the last 30 days → now (if either is unparseable both fall back silently); limit (default 50) and offset (default 0) are clamped to 1–500 and ≥ 0, never rejected. Raw database rows (usage, messages, audit, credits, activity) may carry bigint/numeric columns as JSON strings. Field names are snake_case except in the billing relay, which keeps the provider's camelCase.

get.summary: Caller identity and build (smoke test)

caller.description: The audit actor of this request: a valid X-Operator-Actor, else the caller's service-account e-mail ('dev' with the dev token)

get.summary: This build's model registry
get.description: What this deployment can run, per model tier. A console or benchmark service cannot know it otherwise. Local-LLM ids are left out. Cache-Control: no-store.

get.summary: Admin action audit trail, newest first

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of action, target_id, target_type or actor (trimmed)

post.summary: Record an action the console performed elsewhere
post.description: Keeps one admin_audit trail: the console logs actions it performed outside this API. actor = X-Operator-Actor or the caller. Once the body validates the answer is 201 — the insert is fire-and-forget like every audit write, so a database failure is logged, not returned.

payload.description: At most 8 KiB as JSON; never secrets or document content

post.summary: An operator signed in to the console
post.description: Shifts the deployment-wide login pair (current → previous, current = now). 'previous' is the reference point of 'new users since last login' (GET /new-users, GET /users totals.new_users_count). Global, not per operator; shared with the legacy password login. No body; not audited.

previous_login_at.description: The login before this one; null on a fresh install

get.summary: Signups since the operator's previous login
get.description: since = the previous login (7 days ago on a fresh install), or the last POST /new-users/seen when that is more recent.

post.summary: Reset the new-users reference point to now
Send the weekly operator summary e-mail now (same as the cron)
Run the context-alert digest sweep now (same as the cron)
Run the plan-expiry reminder sweep now (same as the cron)
Re-insert paid Stripe subscription invoices missing from the revenue ledger
post.description: Idempotent repair of billing_revenue; safe to re-run. Not audited. NOTE: the /billing relay is mounted ahead of this route and gates every /billing/* path, so without the billing-provider seam this answers 503 BILLING_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE even when Stripe is configured.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Look-back window in days; clamped to 1–1095, 0 or non-numeric → 365

503.description: Stripe not configured ({detail}) — or the billing-provider gate ({code: BILLING_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, detail})

patch.summary: Assign or clear a user's manual tier override
patch.description: tier_level_id null, absent or equal to the free level clears the override (the user is free on the next request) — an empty body therefore clears. A paid level takes effect immediately; it must exist (POST /tiers first) and `until`, when given, must be in the future (null = no expiry). Clears ignore `until`. Records tier_change_history (source admin) and, for users linked to the external membership partner (wp_user_id) with the partner push configured, mirrors the change there best-effort. Audited as user.tier.set / user.tier.clear.

until.description: Expiry of a paid grant; non-string values are ignored

400.description: Invalid user id | Invalid tier_level_id | Invalid until date | until must be in the future | Unknown tier_level_id N

patch.description: A present string updates the field (trimmed; "" → cleared); null clears; an absent or non-string key leaves it unchanged. Audited as user.profile.update.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 expected; not validated, truncated to 120 chars

400.description: Invalid user id | Nothing to update

post.summary: Ban or unban the user's sign-in account (Supabase Auth)
post.description: Any action other than "unban" bans. Audited as user.suspend (payload {hours}) / user.unsuspend.

hours.description: Ban length; non-positive or missing → 876000 (≈100 years, effectively permanent); capped at 876000

409.description: The user has no Supabase account (legacy login) — also the answer for an unknown user id

get.summary: Every tier definition with entitlements, marketing copy and live user counts

post.description: Upsert: an existing tier_level_id is overwritten — scalars replaced, entitlements merged over the stored ones, marketing untouched — and still answers 201. Unknown entitlement keys and wrong types are dropped silently. Audited as tier.create.

400.description: Invalid tier_level_id | tier_slug required | display_label required | daily_tokens out of range

get.summary: Alias of GET /tiers
get.description: Same handler and response as GET /tiers (kept for older clients).

patch.summary: Update a tier's label, slug, daily quota, entitlements or marketing copy
patch.description: Only the fields sent change. entitlements is shallow-merged (unknown keys / wrong types dropped silently); marketing replaces the stored copy whole and is ignored unless both locales.hr and locales.en are objects; blank display_label / tier_slug are ignored; daily_tokens null counts as 0. A body that leaves nothing valid answers 400. Feature-gate and plan-catalogue caches are busted on this instance; others refresh within their TTL (≈30–60 s). Audited as tier.update.

400.description: Invalid tier_level_id | daily_tokens out of range | No fields to update

get.summary: The code-defined catalogue of every entitlement key
get.description: Type, editor group, hr/en label and per-tier default of each key; an editor renders from this so it cannot drift from the keys the deployment accepts.

get.summary: A user's token-credit grants (voided included) and live bonus balance
get.description: userId is not validated here: a malformed id answers 500.

bonus_remaining.description: Unconsumed tokens of live (unvoided, unexpired, not used up) packs

post.summary: Grant a token-credit pack (bank transfer or discretionary)
post.description: Card purchases are granted by the Stripe webhook, never here. granted_by_admin_id stays null on this surface — the operator identity is in admin_audit. userId is not validated (malformed or unknown → 500), and an unparseable expires_at answers 500 rather than 400. Audited as credits.grant.

400.description: tokens_granted out of range | payment_method must be bank_transfer or admin_manual

post.summary: Void a credit grant (soft delete; excluded from the balance from now on)
post.description: Audited as credits.void. A malformed id answers 500.

404.description: Credit not found or already voided

get.summary: Growth, usage and revenue time series plus the tier distribution
get.description: daily is dense (one entry per UTC day in [from, to), zero-filled). Revenue = token packs + subscription invoices, EUR cents. tiers is a current snapshot by effective tier. revenue_metrics is anchored to now (independent of the window): MRR = subscription revenue of the last 30 days, ARR = trailing 365 days, bridge/NRR = last 30 days vs the 30 before, per payer.

serviceIdentity.description: A Google-signed OIDC identity token of a service account (no shared password). Accepted when the signature verifies against Google's keys, email_verified is true and the email (case-insensitive) is listed in OPERATOR_API_CALLERS (separated by ',', ';' or whitespace — ';' survives gcloud's comma-split env flags), and aud is one of OPERATOR_API_AUDIENCE (same separators, trailing '/' ignored) or, when that is unset, this host's origin https://{Host} or https://{Host}/operator/v1. OPERATOR_API_CALLERS unset or empty ⇒ the API does not exist: every path answers 404 before the token is looked at. Outside production (NODE_ENV ≠ production) the static OPERATOR_API_DEV_TOKEN is accepted as well (audit actor fallback 'dev'), still only when OPERATOR_API_CALLERS is set.

actor.name: X-Operator-Actor
actor.description: The human or tool behind this request (e.g. an operator's e-mail). Trimmed; anything not matching the pattern is ignored silently. Recorded as admin_audit.actor for every audited action and echoed by GET /whoami; absent or invalid → the caller's service-account e-mail ('dev' with the dev token). Trusted only because the caller itself is authenticated.

from.name: from
from.description: Inclusive lower bound (ISO 8601); default now − 30 days

days.name: days
days.description: Window in whole days ending today (UTC); clamped to 1–365

Unauthorized.description: Missing bearer token | Invalid caller token

ServerError.description: Database or upstream failure; detail carries the message

BillingInternal.description: INTERNAL — unexpected failure in the core

code.description: e.g. BILLING_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, BILLING_PROVIDER_BAD_ANSWER, USER_REQUIRED, USER_NOT_FOUND, STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVE, PLAN_INVALID, NOT_FOUND, QUOTE_NOT_FOUND, INVOICE_NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL, or a relayed provider code

GrantKind.description: Who wrote the user's paid grant, from the newest tier history row: manual = an operator (source admin), external = a seam service such as the billing provider (source admin, reason ext:<service>:…), stripe = a Stripe subscription, ump = the partner-site sync; null = no paid grant

tier_level_id.description: Effective tier (an expired override counts as the free level)

grant_expired.description: The paid grant's end date has passed; tier_* already shows the free level

grant_reason.description: Reason on the grant's tier history row

granted_tier_label.description: Label of the granted tier (differs from tier_label once expired)

question_count.description: The user's own messages (regular and project chats) in the range

documents_uploaded.description: document.uploaded audit events in the range (recorded since 2026-08-18)

entitlements.description: Stored overrides over the catalogue defaults (see GET /entitlement-catalog)

price.description: Public monthly price string (the plan catalogue's hr copy); null for tiers without a public plan

user_count.description: Users on this tier through a live (non-expired) override; the free tier is the implicit default

EntitlementsInput.description: Entitlement key → value. Only catalogue keys with the right type survive (bool, or int ≥ 0 floored); everything else is dropped silently.

defaults.description: Per canonical tier key: free, plus, pro, legal_pro, team, eulex_legal_team, enterprise, foundation

PlanMarketing.description: Public plan copy; non-string fields become ""

plans.description: Plan slugs the coupon is restricted to (raw product id when unmapped); [] = every product

stats.description: Revenue attributed to the code by the subscription ledger

AdminUserMcp.description: Per-user MCP badge: desk = built-in tools from in-app chat, connector = external MCP connector (portal manage API); each leg fails soft

AdminQuote.description: The provider's AdminQuote (contracts/billing-provider.openapi.json) with buyer mapped to AdminBuyer, note renamed paidNote, and userEmail added by the core.
